title: GTA6 Australia Age Rating Sparks Intense Reddit Debate
description: GTA6 has reportedly received its official classification in Australia, sparking heavy debate on Reddit. A community post compares its category rankings with GTA5.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Australia Rating Sparks Community Comparison

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to reach fever pitch, the r/GTA6 community on Reddit has been buzzing over a new piece of unverified information regarding the game's classification in Australia.

### Comparing Categories: Pushing the Boundaries Further

According to a post submitted by a community member referencing data from Twitter user Gameroll, details regarding the game's content categories and key rankings have emerged. The community discussion centers around a visual comparison between how content was categorized for previous titles and what has allegedly been assigned to the new installment.

The poster highlighted: "The left image is what GTA VI received and on the right is GTA V's. This helps us put into perspective how far Rockstar is truly pushing things with this game. Pretty nuts considering that GTA V was considered VERY controversial at the time." Additionally, the comparison also touched upon Red Dead Redemption 2's Australian classification for further context. As this information originates from social media leaks and community forums, it should be treated as an unconfirmed rumor for now.

### Looking at Rockstar's Legacy of Controversy

Grand Theft Auto V was renowned for pushing boundaries and generating widespread debate upon its release. If the circulating classification details hold any weight, it suggests that Rockstar Games is continuing to test limits in its open-world design and mature thematic elements. However, players should approach these community comparisons with caution until official, verified announcements are made by authorized classification boards or Rockstar itself.

### Editor's Take

While this Reddit discussion offers a fascinating look at how community members speculate on game content, it is important to remember that classification leaks and early category comparisons are not official announcements. Take these unverified rumors with a grain of salt as we await official word from Rockstar Games.
